description: We are Ground X, a team of six engineering students from the Military Technological College in Oman, bringing together Geomatics, Aviation, and Systems Engineering. Our strength lies in our different skills, shared curiosity, and determination to turn ideas into real solutions. We are passionate about space exploration and excited to use NASA’s open data to explore how places on Earth compare with environments on the Moon and Mars. We’re here to learn, collaborate, and make our work count.
